description: This file defines a React component library for a customizable combobox UI element, including various subcomponents such as input, trigger, popup, items, chips, and utility hooks, with styling and context management.

methods.name: Combobox
methods.description: Main component providing context and ref management for the combobox.

methods.name: ComboboxChipsInput
methods.description: Input component styled for chips within the combobox.

methods.name: ComboboxInput
methods.description: Main input component with trigger and clear button functionalities.

methods.name: ComboboxTrigger
methods.description: Button to trigger the dropdown popup.

methods.name: ComboboxPopup
methods.description: Container for the dropdown list of options.

methods.name: ComboboxItem
methods.description: Individual selectable item within the combobox list.

methods.name: ComboboxSeparator
methods.description: Visual separator between groups of items.

methods.name: ComboboxGroup
methods.description: Group container for related items.

methods.name: ComboboxGroupLabel
methods.description: Label for item groups.

methods.name: ComboboxEmpty
methods.description: Display when no items are available.

methods.name: ComboboxRow
methods.description: Row element within the list.

methods.name: ComboboxValue
methods.description: Displays the selected value.

methods.name: ComboboxList
methods.description: Scrollable list container for items.

methods.name: ComboboxClear
methods.description: Button to clear the selection.

methods.name: ComboboxStatus
methods.description: Status message component.

methods.name: ComboboxCollection
methods.description: Collection wrapper for items.

methods.name: ComboboxChips
methods.description: Container for chips representing selected items.

methods.name: ComboboxChip
methods.description: Individual chip component with remove functionality.

methods.name: ComboboxChipRemove
methods.description: Button to remove a chip.

methods.name: useComboboxFilter
methods.description: Hook for filtering combobox items.
